title: Elite (X4: Foundations)
intro: The Elite is a small Argon interceptor with one forward gun. It is flown from a single-pilot cockpit and uses the shared X4 flight controls.

panels.name: Elite: seat and weapons
panels.text: Facts about the Elite that set it apart from other X4 ships: where the pilot sits and which guns, turrets and docking it has.
panels.context: All other controls of the Elite are the shared X4 controls of this guide.

controls.name: Pilot seat
controls.text: The Elite is flown from a cockpit seat, as small and medium ships are. The pilot sits here and has all the controls of this guide.
controls.context: From this seat the pilot sees the HUD, the radar and the monitors of the Elite.

controls.name: Forward gun
controls.text: The Elite has one forward gun that point where the nose points. The pilot fires them with the trigger and aims by turning the whole ship.
controls.context: The aiming mark in front of the target on the HUD shows where to point the nose.

controls.name: Ship class
controls.text: X4 sorts ships by size: S (small), M (medium), L (large) and XL (extra large). The Elite is: S-class interceptor.
controls.context: The size decides whether the ship is flown from a cockpit or a bridge and where it can dock.
